author.title: Level editor — author mode
author.toolbar.label: Level actions
author.confirm.new: Start a new level? The current draft will be replaced.
author.confirm.load: Load level {id}? The current draft will be replaced.
author.status.saved: Draft saved in this browser at {time}.
author.status.loaded: Level {id} loaded: edit it, then download the file.
author.status.downloaded_with_errors: level.yaml downloaded, but {count} error(s) remain to fix before proposing it.
author.section.steps.help: One new notion per step. Alternate explanations and code exercises.
author.level.id.help: Two digits, a dash, a short lowercase name (e.g. 08-functions). It must equal the folder name levels/<id>/.
author.level.title: Level title
author.level.xp.help: Awarded once, at the end of the level.
author.level.requires.help: Informative only: never prevents opening the level.
author.step.title: Step {n} — {type}
author.step.text.help: Short sentences. Inline code goes between backticks: `print()`.
author.step.voice.help: Adds a "Listen" button. The audio file is then generated with make voice.
author.step.image.help: Path relative to the level folder.
author.step.starter.help: It must run as is, without errors, and must not already pass the tests (except for a "run to see" step).
author.step.hints.help: One hint per line, from vaguest to most precise. Same count in French and English.
author.step.solution.help: Required: it is executed to check that the tests are right.
author.test.title: Test {n}
author.test.name: Variable name
author.test.value.newline: Exact output: press Enter at the end of the text to expect a final line break (print adds one).
author.test.value.regex: Regular expression applied to the whole output. If the program asks for input, the prompt is part of the output.
author.test.valueType.help: An integer and a decimal that are equal (10 and 10.0) count as the same value; add a "variable type" test to tell them apart.
author.test.inputs.help: One per line, answered in order to input(). The test is then evaluated on a replay of the code with these inputs.
author.test.message.label: Failure message
author.kind.no_syntax_error.help: The code runs without a syntax error.
author.kind.stdout_equals.help: Everything printed, final line break included.
author.kind.stdout_contains.help: A piece of text present in the output.
author.kind.stdout_matches_regex.help: Useful for randomness or varying output.
author.kind.code_contains.help: Checks the use of a notion (e.g. random.choice, while).
author.kind.var_equals.help: Value of a variable after execution.
author.kind.var_type_is.help: Type of a variable after execution (str, int, float…).
author.mission.title: Mission title
author.mission.tests.help: Without tests, the mission is validated with a simple "I understand" button (like level 00).
author.check.help: Runs, with real Python, each exercise's solution (it must pass its tests) and its starter code (it must not pass them).
author.check.failed: Some exercises have problems (see the checks).
author.check.fix_structure: First fix the structure errors reported in the checks.
author.preview.help: Plays this level in the real learner interface. Progress is not saved.
author.export.step1: Download level.yaml (toolbar) and place it in levels/<id>/level.yaml.
author.export.step2: Add the level to levels/manifest.json (line below).
author.export.step4: If steps have narration enabled, run make voice and add the audio files.
author.export.step5: Run make test, then propose your contribution (see CONTRIBUTING.md).
lint.schema_pattern: Invalid format (two digits, dash, lowercase name).
lint.schema_range: Value out of range, or list too short.
lint.hint_count_differs: Hint counts differ: {fr} in French, {en} in English.
lint.id_already_exists: A level {id} already exists: the file would replace it.
lint.requires_self: A level cannot be its own prerequisite.
lint.hints_missing: No hint: providing at least one helps stuck learners.
lint.kind_unsupported: The "{kind}" test is not handled by the engine yet.
lint.voice_to_generate: Narration enabled on steps {steps}: run make voice to generate the audio before proposing the level.
lint.solution_fails: The solution does not pass its tests: {failures}.
lint.starter_passes: The starter code already passes the tests: the exercise would already be solved.
lint.starter_error: The starter code does not run: {type} — {message}{line}
author.kind.drawing_segments.help: Number of lines drawn by canvas.line: “4” (exactly) or “4+” (at least).
author.kind.drawing_has_line.help: A line between two points, either direction: “0,0 100,0” or with a colour “0,0 100,0 red”. Tolerance 0.5.
author.kind.drawing_colors.help: Colours that must all appear, comma-separated: “red,blue”.
lint.drawing_value_invalid: Malformed drawing test value (see the test type help; colours: black, red, green, blue, orange, purple, gray).
